messages:
Mike: noticing a weird cpu/p99 blip across telemetry workers this morning, correlating with a surge in OTLP export attempts.
Tanvi: where are we seeing it? collector or exporter side?
Mike: exporter side. p99 latency for exporter send loop jumps from ~10ms -> 300ms. CPU on exporter hosts up ~40%.
Sam: any recent deploys to the exporter or batching changes? :eyes:
Mike: no deploys. started after a retention + retry config change yesterday. logs show repeated flush loops and backlog drain.
Julia: can you paste a sample of the exporter logs around the spike?
Mike: sure - snippet:
```
2025-11-19T09:42:11Z exporter::send INFO flushing batch size=128 linger_ms=50 pending=1024
2025-11-19T09:42:11Z exporter::send WARN send_error=timeout attempts=3
2025-11-19T09:42:11Z worker::poll INFO processed=1024 cpu_ms=512 p99_ms=310
```
Tanvi: interesting: batch size 128 + linger 50ms + pending 1024 -> causes threadpool saturation if concurrency limited.
Sam: our OTLP HTTP exporter has an internal threadpool with default max_workers=8. If pending grows > 8 * batch_size we get queue thrash and lots of retries.
Mike: exactly — probes show queue length oscillating every 10s with bursts aligning to coredump of KV-cache eviction.
Julia: quick mitigation: reduce batch_size to 64 and increase max_workers to 16, or enable exponential backoff on retries to avoid tight retry storms.
Sam: can we toggle those via feature flags or config rollout? want minimal blast radius.
Mike: we can flip config in the hosted exporter config map; I'll prepare a canary to 2 nodes first.
Tanvi: suggested config diff:
```
exporter.http.batch_size = 64
exporter.http.linger_ms = 30
exporter.http.max_workers = 16
exporter.http.retry.backoff_ms = 100..1600
```
Julia: also add a jitter to the backoff to break sync: use rand(0, backoff_ms) jitter.
ops-bot: deploy started: telemetry-exporter-config v2025-11-19-canary -> 2 nodes
Sam: after the canary, watch p99 and CPU for 5min buckets. if stable, roll to full.
Mike: canary shows p99 down to ~18ms and CPU normalized. rolling to 25%.
Tanvi: followup: we should add alerting for exporter queue depth > 500 for >1m and a dashboard tile with exporter send concurrency vs host cpu.
Julia: opened dash ticket: https://redwood.atlassian/TP-342 add exporter queue and send_latency panels
Mike: thanks everyone. long-term we should re-evaluate retention/retry interaction; retention trimming caused bursty replays.
Sam: moving to backlog cleanup epic: TP-333. closing this thread once rollout completes.
ci-bot: config rollout succeeded to 25% at 2050012550, next scheduled at 2050012650
Mike: rollout complete, metrics stable, closing. :white_check_mark:
